objective: extend a rain-delayed skincare restock observation with product personification and a JeloCare-owned animated reaction

sourcePost.observedText: She planned to restock skincare products but said the rain prevented her from driving.

copy.post: The last two drops: “Madam abeg, we no agree for overtime o” 😭

media.provenance: Original three-panel fictional skincare-drop storyboard generated for JeloCare, precisely edited to add a JeloCare watermark to each panel, then mechanically converted into a looping GIF.
media.rightsBoundary: No third-party screenshot, identity, footage, audio, GIF, product packshot, comment or source media was reused. The animation makes no product, price, stock, suitability or clinical claim.

correction.reason: The first publication omitted the required JeloCare watermark. It was deleted after explicit replacement confirmation and republished with the watermarked GIF.

measurement.mechanism: Product personification plus a familiar overtime boundary turns the final drops into workers resisting extra duty; the three-panel loop supplies setup, protest and reaction.
measurement.note: The source reply count includes the corrected JeloCare reply. Recheck later; source totals are context, not evidence that this reply caused engagement or conversion.
